name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan) "The Sink" Massive Ice Cream Sundae Challenge (Avoid)
whyItWorks: Logan's most famous tradition (served in a mini kitchen sink), but massive amounts of dairy ice cream, whipped cream, syrups, and chopped nuts trigger osmotic diarrhea and lactose cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Only share a few spoonfuls of the plain vanilla/chocolate ice cream and banana slices with a family group (plus 2 Lactaid pills), and skip the chopped nuts and cherries.
